claim: Seed Loom main now has a governed nightly-ingest execution bridge, but no 2026-10-06 intake branch or bundle existed at inspection time; the immediate bottleneck is evidence execution rather than schema authority.
verifiedFacts: Current main HEAD is 15d5bdd74b6be8d7f2700f8595a2e25c420fcd03 from October 6, 2026.

The live Nightly Knowledge Ingest workflow triggers on automation/nightly-intake-* branches when a governed nightly bundle changes, checks out the exact branch, runs the coordinator, verifies generated paths, and commits candidate records and receipts back to the intake branch.

The canonical coordinator performs a dry-run first, checks runId and normalizedDigest, then runs the canonical ingest command and reports INGESTED_WITH_RECEIPT, DUPLICATE_ALREADY_PRESENT or BLOCKED_WITH_EXPLICIT_REASON.
No branch named automation/nightly-intake-2026-10-06 existed before this run; no main-side run or receipt for run:nightly:2026-10-06 was found.
inference: The repository has crossed from 'bridge missing' to 'bridge present and bounded'; today's task can therefore exercise the actual delivery-to-ingest path rather than merely stage a bundle.
The portfolio's next proof value comes from running the bridge and Issue #24 proof, not from adding more schema or ontology surface.
significance: This is a direct infrastructure-state change for Seed Loom and reduces the justification for additional architecture work before executing the proof path.
assumptions: GitHub Actions will have permission and runner availability to push generated receipts back to the bounded branch.
